metadata.title: Nimbus parental leave and return planning

records.text:
## Company benefit

Employees with six completed months of service at the leave start date may take 12 weeks of company-paid parental leave for a birth, adoption, or foster placement. The benefit is available to each eligible Nimbus parent. Pay is based on contractual base salary; bonuses are outside this document.

metadata.title: Nimbus parental leave and return planning

records.text:
## Taking leave

Leave must begin within 12 months of the qualifying event. It may be taken in two blocks, each at least two weeks long. Submit the proposed schedule eight weeks ahead when foreseeable. An unexpected placement may be reported as soon as practical; lack of eight weeks' notice does not itself remove eligibility.

metadata.title: Nimbus parental leave and return planning

records.text:
## Return arrangement

For the first four weeks after return, an employee may request 80% scheduled hours at full base salary. The manager and People Operations record the schedule before return. This arrangement is separate from the annual vacation table in source-01.

metadata.title: Nimbus parental leave and return planning

records.text:
## Local entitlement interaction

People Operations must reconcile local entitlements and company benefit in writing. Do not add periods together or infer a legal maximum from this document. Medical information belongs in the restricted personnel case, not the team handover.

# Return handover checklist

Record version: 1.0. Owner: People Operations. Access scope: workshop-public.
Record type: checklist.

Published: 2026-10-09. Effective: 2026-10-09 onward.
Before a Nimbus employee returns, the manager confirms role priorities, identifies training missed during leave, and schedules a first-week check-in. IT revalidates access rather than copying a colleague's permissions. Record an agreed 80% schedule in the personnel case and publish only availability in the team calendar. The checklist does not create a different leave entitlement. If local entitlement reconciliation is pending, People Operations resolves that issue before the manager promises a final schedule.

## Relationship to policy
Read alongside current-policy.pdf. This record supplements the collection and does not supersede the full policy. Case records, exercises, and proposals describe their stated context; they are not general policy changes.
